name: New York Custom Interior Millwork Corp
old_description: New York Custom Interior Millwork is family-owned and has been in business for generations. We specialize in sophisticated and distinguished commercial and residential architectural custom woodwork. Our core values are synonymous with the quality and integrity of our craftsmanship and the foundation on which the company was built. New York Custom Interior Millwork is devoted to superior customer satisfaction and artisanal creations that beautify all interiors.
about:
New York Custom Interior Millwork Corp. was founded in 1972 by Teddy Lagos, who opened a retail woodworking shop on Fifth Avenue in Manhattan. The family-owned business later expanded to a showroom and manufacturing plant in Long Island City before establishing its headquarters in Astoria, Queens. In the 2000s, Lagos’s daughter, Elizabeth Lagos-Molinari, assumed leadership after earning an MBA from St. John’s University and working alongside her father. She now runs the company with her father serving as a mentor and consultant.

The firm produces custom architectural millwork for high-end commercial and residential projects. Its capabilities span in-house design, fabrication, finishing, and installation, all performed in a state-of-the-art facility. The company works with wood as well as a range of non-wood architectural materials, offering complete turnkey solutions from concept through final fit-out.

Primary clients include architects, interior designers, real estate developers, and construction managers. The portfolio references work in stadiums, broadcast studios, luxury hotels, and five-star restaurants across the United States and internationally.

The founder’s original goal was to create quality woodwork while treating customers as he would want to be treated. That principle, combined with a commitment to craftsmanship and long-term relationships, remains the company’s stated differentiator.
